title: Jeremiah's message about the yoke of Babylon to the surrounding kings
description: God commands Jeremiah to make a yoke and send it to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon with the message that they must serve Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, to avoid punishment. The prophet also warns against false prophets who promise quick deliverance, emphasizing that submission is the only path to survival.
